detail.title: INTEX IT-1605 W SMPS & USB Computer Cabinet
detail.overview: The INTEX IT-1605 W Computer Cabinet is engineered for reliable performance, efficient cooling, and long-lasting durability. Featuring a robust metallic steel body, this cabinet offers excellent protection for internal components while maintaining optimal airflow through dedicated CPU and PCI graphic heat vents. The stylish front mesh design enhances ventilation and gives the cabinet a modern professional look. With support for Micro ATX and Mini ATX motherboards, multiple USB ports, front audio and microphone connectivity, and ATX PSU compatibility, the IT-1605 W is an ideal choice for office, home, and custom PC builds.
